Pacific Horizon Residence

Coastal Living, Intelligently Connected

Overlooking the Pacific, this contemporary residence was designed around openness, natural light, and uninterrupted ocean views. PROJECT:automate developed an integrated technology experience that complements the architecture while giving the homeowners effortless control over their environment.

Main System Features

From lighting and shading to entertainment, climate, security, and networking, every system works together discreetly—allowing the technology to disappear while the experience remains.

  • Centralized whole-home automation and control
  • Intelligent architectural lighting
  • Automated shades and privacy control
  • Multi-room audio and video distribution
  • Dedicated media and entertainment spaces
  • Enterprise-grade networking and Wi-Fi
  • Integrated surveillance and access control
  • Energy monitoring and intelligent power management

Project Gallery
View More Details

Technology Designed Around the View

The architecture of Pacific Horizon Residence was created to maintain a constant connection with the surrounding coastline. Expansive glass, open living spaces, and carefully selected natural materials shaped the character of the home.

The technology needed to support that vision without competing with it. PROJECT:automate planned every system around the architecture, placing controls, speakers, sensors, equipment, and wiring where they would remain discreet and visually unobtrusive.

Effortless Whole-Home Control

Lighting, shades, climate, entertainment, security, and selected exterior systems are brought together through one intuitive control experience.

Instead of managing multiple applications or interfaces, the homeowners can adjust individual rooms or activate complete scenes with a single command.

Customized scenes such as Welcome, Entertain, Evening, and Away allow the residence to respond naturally throughout the day.

Lighting That Complements the Architecture

A centralized lighting system provides precise control throughout the interior and exterior spaces.

Carefully programmed scenes adjust the atmosphere for everyday living, entertaining, dining, and relaxation. Exterior and landscape lighting also highlight the architecture after sunset while maintaining a warm, understated appearance.

Comfort, Privacy and Natural Light

Automated shading helps manage the home’s expansive glass without compromising its ocean views.

The shades can respond to the time of day, sunlight, temperature, or personalized scenes—reducing glare, protecting interior finishes, improving comfort, and providing privacy when required.

Entertainment Without Visual Clutter

Audio and video systems were integrated into the residence with minimal visual impact.

Architectural speakers deliver balanced sound across the primary living areas, while discreet displays and centralized equipment preserve the clean interior design. Entertainment can follow the homeowners seamlessly from indoor spaces to the exterior living areas.

A Network Built for the Entire Home

A reliable network forms the foundation of every connected experience within the residence.

The system was engineered to provide consistent wired and wireless coverage across the home, outdoor entertaining areas, security devices, automation systems, and high-bandwidth entertainment equipment.

Quiet, Connected Protection

Integrated surveillance, access control, and remote monitoring provide greater awareness without making the residence feel dominated by security equipment.

Homeowners can view cameras, receive alerts, verify visitors, and manage entry points whether they are at home or away.

The Result

Pacific Horizon Residence demonstrates how thoughtful technology can support exceptional architecture without becoming the focus.

Every system works quietly in the background, leaving the homeowners with an experience defined by comfort, simplicity, security, and control.
